shared_elements: horizontal register or band of repeated motifs
raised-relief outlines with flat interior surfaces
justification: Both are low-relief carvings organised into horizontal registers with profile figures, but the depicted content is quite different: A shows a narrative military scene of helmeted human archers and soldiers advancing on a walled, towered city with battering ram, while B shows isolated animals (a quadruped with open jaws, a large long-necked bird, snake-like and plant-like forms) and a row of repeated loop/H-shaped signs with no narrative or human figures. The only correspondences — profile orientation, banded layout, relief technique — are generic conventions that unrelated carving traditions produce independently.
